title: Details Command
description: Detail drawings of picked walls, doors and windows, stored by Forsk ids and drawn at every Print on detail sheets (A-50-001…). add: one detail per element (refs, or the picked walls and openings); one that has a detail already is not added again. remove: the ids given, or all. list: what is stored.

ids.description: remove only: which details (DET01, DET02). Omit to remove every one.

refs.description: add only: walls by forsk:id and openings by their marker's forsk:id. Omit to use the selection.
